90 秒英文講解，附 AWS 對照: 90-second walkthrough in English, with AWS comparison
AWS 上同一張表是 S3 Tables 裡的 Iceberg 表（型別名稱改用: On AWS the same table is an Iceberg table in S3 Tables (type names follow Iceberg: string, long, timestamptz…), usually written directly from MSK by Amazon Data Firehose, or by a Glue streaming job. The concept is identical: keep the data as is and add metadata columns.
AWS 上同樣的 SQL 可以在 Athena 或 Glue Spark 跑，結: On AWS the same SQL can run in Athena or Glue Spark, with results written to an Iceberg table. The difference is refresh: there is no materialized view with automatic incremental refresh, so you schedule CTAS / MERGE INTO yourself (or use a Redshift materialized view).
AWS 上這個 app 常見是 API Gateway + Lambda 呼叫: On AWS this app is usually API Gateway + Lambda calling the endpoint, with the front end hosted separately. The calculation logic is the same.
AWS 側用 SageMaker Experiments: Use SageMaker Experiments on the AWS side
AWS 側監控用 SageMaker Model Monitor: Use SageMaker Model Monitor for monitoring on the AWS side
AWS 官方文件原文：需要 Feature Store 或 Canvas 時用: The AWS documentation says it directly: use SageMaker Studio when you need Feature Store or Canvas, so the data and ML experiences are still separate. On Databricks, features are UC objects.
AWS 常見是 Managed Service for Apache Flink: On AWS this is usually Managed Service for Apache Flink computing sliding windows, then calling PutRecord to write into Feature Store. Note two things: Feature Store needs a record identifier (here store and SKU are concatenated into store_sku) and an event time; batch uses Spark and streaming uses Flink, which are two separate engines.
AWS 現在主推 SageMaker AI 上的 managed MLflow（: AWS now promotes managed MLflow on SageMaker AI (MLflow Apps, available in the Singapore Region); Experiments remains only in Studio Classic.
Agent 的每一步都被記成一個 span：用了哪個工具、讀了哪份文件、花了多久: Every step of the agent is recorded as a span: which tool it used, which document it read, how long it took. Answers can be traced back to gold tables, the forecast endpoint and contract terms. That is auditable GenAI. The final step only 'drafts' the order; a person approves it.
AgentCore Observability 用 OpenTelemetry: AgentCore Observability records spans with the same structure using OpenTelemetry (in CloudWatch); tools are wrapped as MCP through AgentCore Gateway, and AgentCore Policy decides what the agent can call. The structure is almost the same; the difference is that data and tool permissions belong to different services.
Auto Loader 只吃「檔案」，不讀 Kafka。AWS 沒有一對一的服務: Auto Loader only ingests 'files'; it does not read Kafka. AWS has no one-to-one service; it is usually assembled from S3 events + Glue bookmarks.
Auto Loader（cloudFiles）只處理新到的檔案。兩個要記住的細節: Auto Loader (cloudFiles) only processes newly arrived files. Two details to remember: (1) CSV / JSON columns are inferred as STRING by default (unless you enable cloudFiles.inferColumnTypes), leaving type casting to silver; (2) it adds _rescued_data automatically, so values that do not match the schema land in this column instead of disappearing. When a new column appears, the default addNewColumns mode stops, updates the schema and restarts; rescue mode holds the values as in the table above.
Auto Loader（cloudFiles）只讀雲端儲存上的檔案，不讀 Kaf: Auto Loader (cloudFiles) only reads files on cloud storage; it does not read Kafka. The two halves of the statement also contradict each other.
Batch Transform 讀 S3 上的輸入檔、輸出同名加 .out 的檔: Batch Transform reads input files on S3 and writes output files with the same name plus .out. join_source='Input' joins the input ID columns back onto the output; otherwise you get only a list of predictions and cannot tell which warehouse and SKU each belongs to. It becomes a 'table' only after you load it into Iceberg or Redshift.
Bronze 只做一件事：完整保存。重複（E2）、壞資料（E5）、晚到（E3）全: Bronze does one thing: keep everything. Duplicates (E2), bad records (E5) and late arrivals (E3) are all kept, and the payload is still the raw JSON string. The benefit: if the cleaning logic changes later, you can recompute silver and gold from bronze without going back to the source systems.
CSV 沒有型別：日期和數字都只是文字；store_scope 用 | 把多個國: CSV has no types: dates and numbers are just text; store_scope joins several countries with |. Downstream must split it and cast types before it can be joined with sales data.
DLT 已改名 Lakeflow pipelines（Spark Declara: DLT has been renamed Lakeflow pipelines (Spark Declarative Pipelines). This layer is the core of Databricks data engineering and is worth the most practice time.
DMS 的 CDC 檔每一列多一個 Op 欄（I / U / D），只帶「變更」: Each row of a DMS CDC file has an extra Op column (I / U / D) and carries only the change itself. To merge it into the latest state or an SCD2 history table, you write MERGE INTO yourself in Glue / EMR. Zero-ETL gives you a replicated table directly (latest state), but does not keep every version.
Data Capture + 開源監控方案（SageMaker AI MLflo: Data Capture + an open-source monitoring stack (SageMaker AI MLflow Apps + Evidently AI) + CloudWatch + Quick Sight.
Databricks 用同一個 Spark 引擎做批和流；AWS 常見是 Spa: Databricks uses one Spark engine for batch and streaming; on AWS it is common to use Spark (Glue/EMR) for batch and Flink for streaming, which means two skill sets and two sets of operations.
Databricks：一個 workspace；AWS：Unified Stud: Databricks: one workspace. AWS: Unified Studio covers data and analytics, while Feature Store / Canvas are still in SageMaker AI Studio (stated in the official documentation).
Databricks：模型、表、特徵同一套權限。AWS：Model Regist: Databricks: models, tables and features share one permission model. AWS: Model Registry permissions go through IAM, data permissions through Lake Formation.
Delta 的 _delta_log 是一串 JSON commit（每 10: Delta's _delta_log is a sequence of JSON commits (with a checkpoint every 10). Reading a table starts with the log, which tells you which Parquet files belong to which version, so you get time travel and ACID. The data stays in the customer's own S3.
ERP 仍是下單系統；預測只產生「建議」，由採購核准。: The ERP is still the ordering system; forecasts only produce 'suggestions', which planners approve.
ERP 是 system of record：兩個方案都用 CDC 讀進來，再把: The ERP is the system of record: both solutions read it in through CDC and write suggested orders back. Neither replaces the ERP.
ERP（以 SAP 為例）的庫存表。這是 system of record，平台: The ERP inventory table (SAP as the example). This is the system of record; the platform only reads it and never changes it.
Feature Store in Unity Catalog + Online: Feature Store in Unity Catalog + Online Feature Store (Lakebase)
Feature Store 現在是 UC 物件（Feature Views 或: Feature Store is now a UC object (Feature Views or feature tables; the non-UC Workspace Feature Store is deprecated); online serving is the Lakebase-backed Online Feature Store.
Feature table 就是一張有主鍵的 Delta 表：(store_id: A feature table is just a Delta table with a primary key: (store_id, sku) plus business_date as the TIMESERIES key. Training uses a point-in-time join: each sample only gets features known 'before that day', so there is no peeking into the future. The model remembers which features it used, and lineage connects all the way back to gold.
Glue job 用 job bookmark 記住處理過哪些檔案（靠 tran: A Glue job uses a job bookmark to remember which files it has processed (via transformation_ctx, saved by job.commit() at the end). Types are inferred by Glue, and numbers become bigint. When a new column appears, the DynamicFrame carries it, but the catalog schema has to be updated separately; there is no 'hold it for now' column like _rescued_data.
Gold 是給人和模型用的「答案表」：從 silver 聚合出 units、營收: Gold is the 'answer table' for people and models: units, revenue and transaction counts are aggregated from silver, and a join with the promotion calendar gives is_promo. The other table holds each warehouse's closing stock and inbound purchase orders per day. BI dashboards and ML read the same gold, so the numbers match. The materialized view refreshes incrementally and automatically.
Iceberg 用 metadata.json → manifest list: Iceberg records versions in a tree: metadata.json → manifest list → manifest → Parquet, which also supports time travel. S3 Tables handles compaction and snapshot cleanup automatically. Both sides store Parquet on S3 underneath; the difference is the transaction log format.
Kafka → Auto Loader；或「用 Auto Loader 取代 K: Kafka → Auto Loader; or 'replace the Kafka consumer with Auto Loader'
Kafka 在兩邊都是平台外元件。Databricks on AWS 直接讀 M: Kafka is outside the platform on both sides. Databricks on AWS reading MSK directly is common: this is a point of coexistence, not competition.
Kafka 用 Structured Streaming Kafka sourc: Use the Structured Streaming Kafka source for Kafka; use Auto Loader only for files.
Kafka 的 schema 永遠是這七欄（key、value、topic、pa: The Kafka schema is always these seven columns (key, value, topic, partition, offset, timestamp, timestampType); your fields are all wrapped inside value as BINARY. With store_id as the key, the same store always goes to the same partition, so ordering is guaranteed. Kafka does not remove duplicates caused by POS resends; that is silver's job.
Kafka「微秒級延遲」注入 Bronze: Kafka ingests into Bronze with 'microsecond latency'
Lake Formation 的 data cells filter 同時做列過: A Lake Formation data cells filter does both row and column filtering: excluded columns simply 'disappear' (they are not masked to null), so the structure of downstream reports differs by user. Also, model and endpoint permissions are not in Lake Formation but in IAM.
Lakeflow Jobs 一個 DAG 裡就能放 pipeline、noteb: A single Lakeflow Jobs DAG can hold pipelines, notebooks, conditional branches and dashboard refreshes; data and ML share one scheduler.
ML 這段用 SageMaker Pipelines；資料這段通常是 Glue: The ML part uses SageMaker Pipelines; the data part is usually Glue workflows, Step Functions or MWAA. The two schedulers have to trigger each other (for example through EventBridge). This is an integration cost to state clearly.
MSK 就是 Kafka，這一格兩邊完全一樣：同一個 topic、同一份 sch: MSK is Kafka, so this cell is identical on both sides: same topic, same schema. If you use Kinesis Data Streams instead, the equivalent concepts are partition key, shard and sequence number. Duplicates from POS resends still have to be removed downstream.
Many-models：每個 店 × SKU 序列各訓練一個小模型，平行跑。: Many-models: train one small model per store × SKU series, in parallel.
Model Serving 同時支援 real-time 與 batch inf: Model Serving supports both real-time and batch inference (official documentation). Design latency targets around the SLA, and do not quote numbers without a source.
Model Serving 自動把每次請求和回應寫進 inference tab: Model Serving automatically writes every request and response to an inference table (a Delta table). Data profiling computes distributions and drift on it and produces two tables, profile metrics and drift metrics (drift is shown above). Drift in discount_pct is the promotion starting, which is expected; only drift in p50 relative to the training baseline triggers retraining. Anomaly detection separately checks whether each table arrives on time and has a normal row count. Most forecasting incidents are actually late data.
Model Serving 自動擷取 request/response；Data: Model Serving captures request/response automatically; Data quality monitoring (anomaly detection + data profiling, the latter formerly Lakehouse Monitoring) handles quality and drift.
Model Serving「內建 Lakehouse Monitoring」: Model Serving 'has Lakehouse Monitoring built in'
POS 事件寫進 Kafka topic。Kafka 不解析內容，只存 byte: POS events are written to a Kafka topic. Kafka does not parse the content; it only stores bytes plus position information.
SAP 欄位名是德文縮寫：MATNR 物料號、WERKS 工廠、LGORT 儲位: SAP column names are German abbreviations: MATNR material number, WERKS plant, LGORT storage location, LABST unrestricted stock; material numbers are zero-padded to 18 digits. In silver these all become business names and the SKU format.
SageMaker Feature Store 的模型不一樣：一個 record: SageMaker Feature Store uses a different model: one record identifier (only a single column, so store and SKU are concatenated) plus an event time; there are only three feature types, Integral, Fractional and String, so booleans become 0/1; the offline store automatically adds three columns, write_time, api_invocation_time and is_deleted (written to S3 within about 15 minutes after PutRecord).
SageMaker Model Registry 用 model package: SageMaker Model Registry manages versions with a model package group; the release gate is ModelApprovalStatus (PendingManualApproval → Approved), and deployment is usually triggered by an EventBridge event. Permissions go through IAM, separate from data permissions (Lake Formation).
SageMaker endpoint 不會幫你查特徵：Lambda 要先呼叫 G: A SageMaker endpoint does not look up features for you: Lambda has to call GetRecord first, convert strings to numbers, build the body, then call InvokeEndpoint. The request and response format is defined by the inference container.
SageMaker 的單位是 training job：你的腳本在容器裡自己 f: On SageMaker the unit is the training job: your script fans out inside the container itself (or you split into multiple jobs), the artifact is model.tar.gz on S3, and metrics are scraped from logs with a regex. The per-series results table has to be written to S3 by your script. For low code, you can use time series forecasting in SageMaker Canvas (per item ID); Amazon Forecast is no longer open to new customers.
Silver 依序做六件事：(1) 用 event_id 去重，E2 消失；(2: Silver does six things in order: (1) deduplicate on event_id, so E2 disappears; (2) an expectation drops E5 and counts it, with the number written to the event log; (3) flatten the nested lines into one row per item, so E1 becomes two rows; (4) local time strings plus time zone → UTC timestamp, while keeping the store's local business_date, so the late E3 still counts for the 9th; (5) cast amounts to DECIMAL; (6) loyalty_id is added through schema evolution, null for old data. ERP inventory is also renamed to business names in this layer (second table below).
Unity Catalog 用 row filter（函數決定看哪些列）和 co: Unity Catalog uses row filters (a function decides which rows you see) and column masks (a function decides how a column value is shown). Same table, same SQL: the Thailand buyer sees only TH rows and revenue masked to null. The column itself is still there, so the report structure does not change.
Zero-ETL ↔ Lakeflow Connect；Auto Loader: Zero-ETL ↔ Lakeflow Connect; Auto Loader ↔ S3 events + Glue.
Zero-ETL 對應的是 Lakeflow Connect（CDC），不是 A: Zero-ETL maps to Lakeflow Connect (CDC), not Auto Loader. Which ERP connectors are supported depends on the customer's version; confirm it rather than promising on the spot.
batch inference 寫成一張表: Batch inference written to a table
groupBy + applyInPandas 平行訓練，MLflow 記錄，註: Parallel training with groupBy + applyInPandas, logged in MLflow, registered to UC.
groupBy(store, sku) 把 4.8 萬條序列分給 Spark 的: groupBy(store, sku) distributes 48,000 series across Spark workers, and each is trained on its own. applyInPandas requires the output schema to be declared up front (the five columns in the table above); this is where the schema changes from 'training data' to 'training results'. In practice you wrap all the small models into one MLflow pyfunc 'router model' and register that; at serving time it picks the right small model by store and sku.
「UC 一秒查出哪個上游出錯」: 'UC finds the failing upstream in one second'
「lineage 能從 endpoint 一路追到 POS 表」。: 'Lineage can trace from the endpoint all the way back to the POS table.'
一個 use case、兩套方案：門店 POS 與 ERP 數據進來，倉庫庫存預: One use case, two solutions: store POS and ERP data come in, warehouse inventory forecasts and store sales forecasts go out. Switch between Databricks / AWS: the block positions stay the same, the components change, and you compare cell by cell. All names and links were checked against the official documentation on 2026-10-10.
一家在東南亞有數千家門店的零售商，想同時減少缺貨和庫存積壓。這其實是兩個預測，跑: A retailer with thousands of stores in Southeast Asia wants to reduce both stockouts and excess inventory. This is really two forecasts, running on two different clocks.
一張 gold 同時餵 BI 和 ML，避免兩邊數字不一致。: One gold layer feeds both BI and ML, so the numbers on both sides stay consistent.
一次訓練 = 一個 MLflow run：記下參數、指標和產物。: One training run = one MLflow run: it records parameters, metrics and artifacts.
三家店（新加坡 SG-ORCH-001、吉隆坡 MY-KUL-014、曼谷 TH: Three stores (Singapore SG-ORCH-001, Kuala Lumpur MY-KUL-014, Bangkok TH-BKK-007), two warehouses (DC-SG-01, DC-TH-02), three SKUs, business date 2026-10-09 (Friday), with SKU-20871 at 20% off in SG and MY. The raw data deliberately contains duplicate events, late events, a new column, bad records, nested items, local time strings and zero-padded SAP material numbers; each step handles part of them. All numbers reconcile from start to finish; for example, the final order suggestion 1104 = 46 cases × 24.
不同東西：zero-ETL 是營運資料庫和 SaaS（如 SAP、Salesfo: Different things: zero-ETL is near real-time replication from operational databases and SaaS (such as SAP, Salesforce); Auto Loader is incremental file ingestion.
不講數字；需要更低延遲時提 Structured Streaming real-: Do not quote numbers; if lower latency is needed, mention Structured Streaming real-time mode.
也可以直接雙擊 index.html 或 lab/retail-3d.html：: You can also just double-click index.html or lab/retail-3d.html: there are no external resources, so it works offline.
今天剩下的時間，日內即時: Rest of today, intraday in real time
今天預計賣 205、已賣 31，還要 174；貨架只剩 40，所以中午前從後倉補: Today's forecast is 205, 31 already sold, so 174 still to go; the shelf has only 40 left, so restock 60 from the back room before noon. This is the output the store needs. On Databricks this app can be a Databricks App that reads the endpoint and Lakebase.
促銷、價格、天氣、節日通常比換演算法更能提升準確度——設計時要優先納入。: Promotions, price, weather and holidays usually improve accuracy more than switching algorithms, so include them first in the design.
促銷部門每週丟一份 CSV 到 S3；天氣與節日也是類似的外部檔案或 API。: The promotions team drops a CSV into S3 every week; weather and holidays are similar external files or APIs.
兩邊資料都在客戶自己的 S3、開放格式——Databricks on AWS 不: On both sides the data sits in the customer's own S3 in open formats. Databricks on AWS does not move the data away; it adds a platform on top of the same S3.
兩邊起點相同：POS 是客戶系統，不屬於任何平台。先問峰值 TPS、可接受延遲、: Both sides start in the same place: POS is a customer system and belongs to neither platform. First ask about peak TPS, acceptable latency, and how stores resend data after a network outage.
兩邊都是 MLflow，所以這一格幾乎一樣：參數、指標、產物、tag。wMAPE: Both sides use MLflow, so this cell is almost identical: parameters, metrics, artifacts, tags. wMAPE (weighted mean absolute percentage error) is the most common metric in retail forecasting. The only difference is where the tracking server lives: on Databricks it is built in and natively integrated with Unity Catalog.
兩邊都是開放表格式（Delta / Iceberg），AWS 也不是封閉的。: Both sides use open table formats (Delta / Iceberg); AWS is not closed either.
兩邊都用 MLflow。Databricks 是 MLflow 的原創者，並和: Both sides use MLflow. Databricks created MLflow and integrates it natively with UC. SageMaker Experiments remains only in Studio Classic and is no longer the main option.
加上 GenAI 層（圖中紫色）。: Add a GenAI layer (purple in the diagram).
原始事件刻意埋了六個典型問題：時間是當地時間的「字串」、一筆事件有多個商品、會重: The raw events have six typical problems planted on purpose: time is a local-time “string”, one event holds several items, events get resent (E2), events arrive late (E3), a firmware upgrade adds a new field (E4), and there is occasional bad data (E5). Each later step deals with them one by one.
原封不動落地：每筆 Kafka 訊息變成表裡的一行，加上「從哪來、何時到」。: Land it as is: each Kafka message becomes one row in a table, plus “where it came from and when it arrived”.
合成數據裡的世界: The world in the synthetic data
同一個 MLflow API；tracking server 是 SageMak: Same MLflow API; the tracking server is the SageMaker AI MLflow App, and its ARN is the tracking URI. Models can be set to register automatically in SageMaker Model Registry.
同一張 gold 表，不同的人看到不同的列與欄。: Same gold table, different people see different rows and columns.
同一張表就是圖上每一格的文字版，可以印出來對照。最後一欄是學習重點（中文筆記）。: This table is the text version of every cell in the diagram, so you can print it and compare. The last column has the key points (study notes).
同一批合成數據從 POS 一路走到預測。每一步看「處理前 → 處理後」的資料與: The same synthetic data goes from POS all the way to the forecast. At each step, look at the data and schema “Before → After”: green columns are new, orange columns changed type, and dropped columns are struck through in the Before table. Click any block in the 3D diagram to jump to the same step here; switch between Databricks and AWS to see the actual format differences on each side.
同樣的邏輯在 Glue 或 EMR Serverless 的 Spark 裡自己: You write the same logic yourself in Spark on Glue or EMR Serverless (dropDuplicates, explode, to_timestamp) and write to Iceberg tables in S3 Tables. Data quality uses Glue Data Quality DQDL rules, and the results are stored separately; to “drop bad rows” you filter them yourself, unlike an expectation, where one decorator both blocks and counts them.

On Databricks that is a SQL warehouse (Photon by default); on AWS, Athena or Redshift. The pricing model and the expected concurrency are the design questions to ask first.
參考架構裡的 Delta Sharing 已改名 OpenSharing。零售常: The Delta Sharing in the reference architecture is now called OpenSharing. A common retail use: share sell-through and stock with suppliers (vendor-managed inventory, collaborative replenishment). The key difference is whether the other side must be on the same platform: an OpenSharing recipient does not need Databricks, while Lake Formation sharing needs the supplier to have an AWS account.
這是最關鍵的差異：Databricks 一套權限 + lineage 從 POS: This is the most important difference: on Databricks, one set of permissions and one lineage graph run from the POS table to the endpoint; AWS governance is three layers that have to be kept aligned. Be fair and stick to facts. If the customer already has a Glue Data Catalog, catalog federation can bring it under Unity Catalog first, with tables migrated step by step instead of all at once.
對應官方參考架構最底下那條「身分、安全、監控、成本、DevOps」。這一層兩邊大: This matches the bottom band of the official reference architecture: identity, security, monitoring, cost and DevOps. Most of this layer is the same on both stacks: it lives in the customer's own AWS account (KMS, VPC, CloudTrail) and connects to the same identity provider. What Databricks adds is system tables inside the platform (billing, audit and lineage, all queryable with SQL) and Declarative Automation Bundles. On AWS, a consistent tagging scheme is what lets you add up one pipeline's cost across services.
BI 和 Genie 不直接讀檔案：一個 SQL 引擎對 gold 表跑查詢，權: BI and Genie do not read files directly: a SQL engine queries the gold tables, with the governance layer's permissions applied. The question here: how much did the promotion lift sales, and where?
SQL warehouse 是專門跑 SQL 和 BI 的運算：serverle: A SQL warehouse is compute built for SQL and BI: serverless, it stops when idle, and Photon is the default engine. Whether the query comes from an AI/BI dashboard, Genie or Power BI, Unity Catalog row filters and column masks apply (see the governance layer), so a Thailand planner still sees only TH. Every query is recorded in system tables, so you can audit who queried what.
Athena 直接在 Iceberg 表上跑同一段 SQL，按掃描量計費；高並發: Athena runs the same SQL directly on the Iceberg tables and charges by data scanned; high-concurrency dashboards usually move to Redshift Serverless. Lake Formation data cells filters still apply. The difference is the other side of the join: on AWS the features sit in the SageMaker Feature Store offline store (a table in Glue), keyed by the combined store_sku, and it keeps every write, so the query has to pick the latest record itself.
把 sell-through 分享給供應商：對方查的是活的表，不是每天寄一份 C: Share sell-through with a supplier: they query a live table instead of receiving a CSV every day. Supplier A should see only its own SKU, and no revenue.
OpenSharing 分享的是 UC 裡的表或 view：這裡先用一個 vie: OpenSharing shares tables or views from Unity Catalog. Here a view keeps only the supplier's SKU and drops the revenue columns, and the view is added to a share. The supplier always reads the latest version, with no daily exports; to stop, revoke the recipient. If the supplier also uses Databricks, the table appears directly in its own Unity Catalog.
Lake Formation 可以把一張表或一個 data cells filt: Lake Formation can grant a table or a data cells filter to another AWS account, delivered through AWS RAM; the supplier creates a resource link and queries it with Athena. This assumes the supplier is on AWS, and both sides manage cross-account permissions. Suppliers outside AWS need another route, such as scheduled file exports.
最底層的身分、金鑰、稽核、成本與部署。這裡問：昨天每一條工作負載各花了多少？: The bottom layer: identity, keys, audit, cost and deployment. The question here: what did each workload cost yesterday?
在 Databricks 裡，成本和稽核本身就是表：system.billing: On Databricks, cost and audit are tables: system.billing.usage splits usage by custom tag into workloads, and system.access.audit records who changed permissions. Deployment uses Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles): jobs, pipelines and endpoints are written as YAML, kept in Git and deployed to dev and prod by CI, with the tags fixed in the same files. Keys (KMS), networking (VPC, private connectivity) and CloudTrail stay in the customer's own AWS account, and this part is shared by both designs.
AWS 的成本看 Cost Explorer：以 cost allocation: On AWS, cost is in Cost Explorer, split by cost allocation tags and refreshed at least once every 24 hours; audit is in CloudTrail; deployment uses CloudFormation or CDK. One pipeline's cost is spread across the Glue, EMR, SageMaker AI, Athena and Flink line items, so agree on a tagging scheme from the start or the numbers will not add up.

SCD type 2 的意思：每次變更都保留一個版本，用 __START_AT: SCD type 2 means every change keeps a version, with __START_AT / __END_AT marking the valid period. Old versions are 'closed' rather than overwritten, so you can answer 'what was the stock at 10 pm last night', which is exactly the history model training needs. Database-based ERPs can use a Lakeflow Connect database connector; for SAP, OpenSharing (formerly Delta Sharing) through SAP Business Data Cloud is also common in practice, depending on the customer's SAP version.
